name: Star Wars Per-Attack Air Wing (TIE & Republic)
description: Per-attack Eagle aircraft switch across all 5 texture tiers (full, lighter, reduced1024, reduced512, potato256): EmpireDivers TIE Fighter (strafe/110mm) & TIE Bomber (bombing/support), plus Clonedivers r26 ARC-170 Starfighter (strafe/110mm), BTL-B Y-Wing Bomber (airstrike/500kg/cluster), & LAAT/i Gunship (smoke/gas/napalm), with build-25480438 eagle_base residency and 4-player sortie tracking.
